national_news.title: PM Modi Chairs Semiconductor Roundtable to Drive Tech Collaboration
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the Semiconductor Roundtable with global and Indian industry CEOs in New Delhi to outline India's technology roadmap.
Highlighted key priorities including the India Semiconductor Mission 2.0, emerging technologies like AI and Quantum Computing, and a target to skill 1 crore individuals in AI.
Global industry leaders from companies such as Micron, ASML, Intel, Foxconn, and Tata Electronics committed to building capabilities across semiconductor design, manufacturing, and R&D.

national_news.title: NCB Shifts Strategy to Network-Centric Model Under Vision Document 2026–29
bullets: The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) announced a transition from a seizure-centric to a network-centric model to choke drug financing and dismantle trafficking infrastructure.
The strategy is aligned with the Vision Document on Narcotics Control 2026–29, which sets a three-year roadmap to make India drug-free by July 2029.
The policy focuses on four pillars: intelligence enforcement, synthetic/precursor drug control, demand/harm reduction, and capacity building via Nasha Mukt Bharat Mitras.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Raises EPFO Wage Ceiling from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000 per Month
bullets: The Union Cabinet enhanced the mandatory wage ceiling under the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000 per month.
The decision brings over 51 lakh additional employees under mandatory social security coverage, with an estimated annual government outgo of Rs 11,339 crore.
The revised ceiling expands access to provident fund savings, pension under EPS, and insurance protection under EDLI.

national_news.title: Government Exempts Small Exporters from RCMC Requirement to Reduce Compliance Burden
bullets: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry exempted small-value export consignments up to Rs 3 lakh from the Registration-cum-Membership Certificate (RCMC) requirement.
The measure aims to reduce compliance burdens, facilitating micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), artisans, and first-time exporters.
Consignments exceeding Rs 3 lakh will continue to require a valid RCMC or Certificate of Registration as applicable.

national_news.title: NITI Aayog Releases India Electric Mobility Index 2025; Delhi Tops Ranking
bullets: NITI Aayog launched the second edition of the India Electric Mobility Index (IEMI) 2025, with Delhi emerging as the top-performing State/UT.
Other top-performing states and UTs include Maharashtra, Karnataka, Chandigarh, and Goa, with top scores improving from 77 in 2024 to 84 in 2025.
The index evaluates states across 16 indicators spanning Transport Electrification Progress, Charging Infrastructure Readiness, and EV Research and Innovation Status.

national_news.title: Veteran Actor Anant Nag Conferred Dadasaheb Phalke Award 2024
bullets: Veteran Kannada actor Anant Nag has been named the recipient of the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024 for his contribution to Indian cinema over nearly five decades.
The award will be presented during the 72nd National Film Awards ceremony scheduled to take place in Kevadia, Gujarat.
With a career spanning over 300 films across Kannada, Hindi, Marathi, Telugu, Malayalam, and English, Nag was a key figure in India's parallel cinema movement during the 1970s.

national_news.title: COAS General Dhiraj Seth Embarks on 3-Day Russia Visit to Boost Defence Ties
bullets: Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) General Dhiraj Seth undertook an official three-day visit to Russia from September 16 to 18, 2026, to strengthen bilateral military-to-military cooperation.
Key interactions included meetings with Colonel General Andrei Nikolayevich Mordvichev, Commander-in-Chief of Russian Land Forces, and Deputy Defence Minister Vasily Sergeyevich Osmakov in Moscow.

The visit emphasized co-development and co-production of defence equipment, building upon joint ventures like T-90 tanks, Su-30 MKI assembly, BrahMos exports, and the commissioning of stealth frigate INS Tamal in Kaliningrad.

national_news.title: NHAI to Develop Rs 10,998 Crore Varuna Elevated Corridor in Varanasi
bullets: The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI), under the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, is implementing the 43.218-km Varuna Elevated Corridor project worth Rs 10,998 crore.
The 6/4-lane corridor connects NH-31 directly with the Varanasi Ring Road along the Varuna River, featuring an iconic cable-stayed bridge and extradosed foot over bridges.

Designed for operating speeds of 80-100 kmph, the project aims to cut travel time from Varanasi Junction to Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport to nearly 20 minutes while enhancing access to Kashi Vishwanath Corridor.

national_news.title: Prime Minister to Inaugurate SEMICON India 2026 at Yashobhoomi, Dwarka
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the 3-day SEMICON India 2026 conference on September 17 at Yashobhoomi in Dwarka, New Delhi.
The central theme for SEMICON India 2026 is 'Silicon to Systems: Building the Ecosystem', showcasing India's evolving semiconductor manufacturing and assembly vision.
The event brings together global chipmakers, investors, and policymakers to highlight India's transition from electronics consumption to foundational chip manufacturing.

national_news.title: Finance Ministry Clarifies Zero MDR Framework for UPI Transactions
bullets: The Union Finance Ministry clarified that Person-to-Person (P2P) UPI transactions remain entirely free of charges regardless of the transferred amount.

Under the revised Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) framework introduced via the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, Person-to-Merchant (P2M) transactions up to ₹2,000 remain free, while transactions above ₹2,000 attract a nominal 0.4% MDR.
A dedicated UPI promotion fund for small merchants will be created using 5% of total MDR collections, ensuring small merchants receiving up to ₹1 lakh monthly retain zero MDR.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Drafts Building Bye-Laws 2026 and Regulatory Reforms
bullets: The Bihar Government prepared the draft Bihar Building Bye-Laws 2026 under Deregulation 1.0 and 2.0 reforms, proposing self-certification for low-risk buildings and third-party inspections for medium-risk buildings.
The Bihar Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) Bill 2026 was approved on July 23, 2026, offering dual licensing relief and MSME self-declaration protections.
A centralised digital repository for government rules was launched on June 19, 2026, alongside the RTPS auto-appeal system launched on June 23, 2026.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Approves ₹2,520 Crore Makeover for Vishnupad Temple in Gaya
bullets: The Bihar government approved a ₹2,520 crore proposal to develop the premises and neighbouring areas of the historic Vishnupad Temple in Gaya on the lines of the Kashi Vishwanath Corridor.
The temple is dedicated to Lord Vishnu, featuring a 40 cm sacred footprint, and is globally renowned for the Pinda Daan ritual performed for ancestors.
The development plan includes multi-level car parking, elevated pathways, ghats along the Phalgu River, Sita Kund, and enhanced public amenities.

bihar_news.title: ISMA Estimates India's Residential Rooftop Solar Potential at 132 GW
bullets: According to an ISMA report, India's residential rooftop solar market has a total potential of 132 GW, with about 115 GW yet to be deployed.
The PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana launched in February 2024 has been a primary catalyst, contributing around 13.45 GW of rooftop solar capacity by July 2026.
As of August 2026, about 77.85 lakh households registered under the scheme with 14,953 MW of installations completed, led by Gujarat, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Kerala, and Rajasthan.

bihar_news.title: Union Agriculture Minister Visits Bihar to Review Flood Situation
bullets: Union Minister for Agriculture Shivraj Singh Chouhan visited Bihar to inspect flood-affected areas, evaluate crop damage, and review emergency relief operations.
The high-level review meeting at the Chief Minister's Secretariat 'Samvad' in Patna was held with state officials to assess flood disaster management.
The Union Minister conducted aerial surveys and visited relief camps in districts like Dighwara, Maner, Munger, and Bhagalpur.

bihar_news.title: Around 50 Lakh People Affected by Floods Across 15 Districts in Bihar
bullets: Approximately 50 lakh people across 575 panchayats in 15 districts of Bihar remained affected by floodwaters, with submergence reported in parts of Katihar.
The India Meteorological Department and local authorities issued rain alerts and lightning warnings for multiple districts in the state.
Relief and rescue operations, including the distribution of relief supplies and monitoring of embankments, were intensified across the affected zones.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Distributes Gratuitous Relief (GR) via DBT to Flood Victims
bullets: The Bihar government initiated financial assistance distribution to flood-affected families through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) under Gratuitous Relief (GR).
Special programs were organized in Patna to ensure transparent and direct transfer of relief funds to the bank accounts of disaster-hit citizens.
State leadership oversaw the disbursement process to accelerate relief and rehabilitation measures for families displaced by rising river waters.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Pulls Up States Over Menstrual Hygiene Compliance in Schools
bullets: The Supreme Court expressed dissatisfaction with States and Union Territories over compliance reports regarding menstrual hygiene facilities in schools.

The bench of Justices JB Pardiwala and R Mahadevan examined affidavits in the case 'Jaya Thakur v. Government of India & Ors. (2026)', highlighting data discrepancies in states like Jharkhand and Bihar.

The Court oversees the implementation of the Union government's Menstrual Hygiene Policy for School-going Girls in Classes 6 to 12, mandating gender-segregated toilets, free sanitary napkins, and proper waste-disposal systems.

bihar_news.title: SJVN Commissions Unit-II of 1,320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar
bullets: SJVN Limited commissioned the 660 MW Unit-II of the 1,320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project located at Chausa in Buxar district, Bihar.
Developed using supercritical technology at an investment of Rs 137.57 billion, the project comprises two 660 MW units with Unit-I previously operationalized in November 2025.
The project will generate 9,828.72 million units of electricity annually, with 85 percent allocated to Bihar under a long-term power purchase agreement to strengthen regional energy security.
